walkthrough.short: One short line across the set, hands along it, and balance forwards and back.
walkthrough.long: The four of you make one short line straight across the set, looking up and down it rather than at each other. The two in the middle take hands there by the {hand}, and each gives their other hand to the dancer on their own end, so everybody looks the opposite way to the dancers beside them. Step forwards on the first beat and back to the line on the third.

walkthrough.short: One short line across the set, hands along it, and balance left then right.

The two in the middle take hands there by the {hand}, and each gives their other hand to the dancer on their own end. Balance to your own left on the first beat and to your own right on the third.

call.long: BALANCE THE WAVE LEFT AND RIGHT
